meta.name: atl-messaging
meta.description: Writes cold emails targeted at VP, C-Level, and Director personas (Above-the-Line). Use when the user asks to "email a CEO", "email a VP", "executive outreach", "C-suite email", "above the line", "ATL messaging", "email to decision maker", or targets someone with a VP/C-Level/Director title. Also triggers on "strategic messaging", "board-level email", "executive cold email". Do NOT use for emails targeting managers or individual contributors (use btl-messaging), general email writing without a specified persona, or deliverability questions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 撰写针对公司高管的冷邮件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要向 VP、CTO 等高管发送专业冷邮件
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send professional cold emails to C-level or VP executives

howto.what: 该技能让Claude编写面向副总裁、首席级别和总监（Above-the-Line）的冷邮件。邮件仅2-3句，使用战略语言（如收入影响、风险降低），不涉及操作细节。若有ColdIQ连接，会在起草前获取人员画像和信号。
howto.when: 当用户要求写冷邮件且目标对象是VP、C-Level或Director（如“给CEO发邮件”“高管推广”等关键词）时触发。不用于经理或个体贡献者。

say.text: 帮我写一封给CEO的冷邮件
say.note: 触发ATL邮件，Claude将使用战略语言简短撰写。

say.text: 写一封面向VP的商务邮件
我需要发一封高管级别的推广邮件
say.note: 技能将产出针对高层的战略冷邮件。

howto.what_en: This skill makes Claude write cold emails for VP, C-Level, and Director personas (Above-the-Line). Emails are 2-3 sentences with strategic language (e.g., revenue impact, risk mitigation), no operational details. If ColdIQ is connected, it enriches person data and finds signals before drafting.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user requests a cold email targeting a VP, C-Level, or Director (e.g., 'email a CEO', 'executive outreach', 'ATL messaging'). Does not trigger for managers or individual contributors.

say_en.text: Write a cold email to a CEO.
say_en.note: Triggers ATL messaging with strategic language and 2-3 sentences.
Claude generates a concise strategic email for a VP.

say_en.text: I need an executive cold email.
say_en.note: Produces a brief, high-level cold email for a C-suite persona.
